- **Dry run definition:** "dry run" means different things in different migration tools. Unless you name your tool, I will define it by what the agent can observe. The agent runs the migration in generate-only mode or against a non-staging copy, then shows the output before it applies anything.
- **File location:** I will create the file under the current directory at `skills/migration-dry-run/`. Your global notes say personal skills live in `~/Projects/agent-skills/skills`. Tell me if you want it there instead.
